name: SubDL Scribe
description: SubDL Scribe brings SubDL.com to Jellyfin: it downloads missing subtitles for the languages and libraries you pick and uploads your own. Download is on by default; upload is off — enable at your choice. Requires a SubDL login and API Key plus a TMDb API Key.
overview: Sync subtitles with SubDL — download missing and upload new subtitles.

versions.changelog:
v12.1.12.186: The time the audio alignment spends no longer counts against the download pacing.
    The alignment runs between two downloads, so its duration sat inside a wait that was meant for
    transferring; it is now measured and taken off the next wait, never below zero, and only in the
    download direction. An alignment that found nothing to correct costs the same as one that
    corrected a file, so both are credited. The run's closing line reports the cost: how many
    subtitles were aligned and how many seconds it took.
